integrity: The upper bound is an explicit finite-variable definition and the lower bound is an all-round k-pebble Duplicator strategy. A finite checker independently sanity-checks the lower-bound back-and-forth relation for 1<=r,s<=4 but is not used as a proof of the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Balanced complete multipartite graphs only; ordinary first-order graph logic without counting; no formula-length or quantifier-depth claim and no classification for unequal part sizes.
title: Logical width of balanced complete multipartite graphs
